title: Lut Gaya Fatema Zehra ka Chaman
body:
Lut gaya Fatima zahra ka chaman Aj ki raat,
Bhai k sog me baithi h bahen Aj ki raat,,
Haye pardes me kya kya na masayeb toote,
Yaad aaya h sakina ko watan ajki raat,
Kal talak sath the her gaam pe jo zainab k,
Soye hain run me wo begoro kafan aj ki raat,
Loot k le gayi ek din me khiza Sara chaman,
Chand ko lag gaya zahra k gahen aj ki raat,
Aashiya jal gaya ab raat hai or jungle hai,
Sar chhupayenge Kahan tashna dahen aj ki raat,
Boli zainab kyu shabe gham ye guzarti hi nahi,
Mere mabood hai kis darja kathan aj ki raat,
Baaliya dedo meri beti ki kahti thi rabab
Kis qadar todoge ik maa pe mehan aj ki raat ,
Khaak udate hain malak gham me ye kiske ae suhail,
Ashk barsata hai kyu charkhe kohan aj ki raat
